'''Jo Armeniox''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Armeniox has been acting since 2006, mostly playing minor roles in a number of American TV shows. However, in 2014, she was cast in her best known role as the voice of {{an|Shauna}} in {{aniseries|XY}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Armeniox has since been cast in a few additional roles in {{aniseries|SM}}.
